entities.description: A close-up view of a person riding a bicycle, showing their hands gripping the handlebars and their lower torso. The bicycle has silver, curved handlebars with black grips and a visible brake lever. The rider is wearing a pink, dirt-stained t-shirt and dark patterned pants with floral and leaf designs. A large, burlap sack is strapped to the back of the bicycle, partially visible on the right side of the frame.

A large, coarse burlap sack made of light tan woven jute fabric is shown in a close-up, with its top edge rolled over and frayed. A person's hand is visible inside the opening, and the sack is positioned on a black metal stand or cart frame.

attributes.position: resting on a black metal frame
attributes.interaction: a hand is reaching into the top opening

entities.description: A man with short, dark curly hair and a beard is bending forward, reaching into a large, open burlap sack. He is wearing a short-sleeved t-shirt with a color-block design of navy blue on the top and beige on the bottom, paired with dark, knee-length shorts that appear to be made of a durable fabric. His skin is dark, and his expression is focused on the task at hand.

clothing.shirt: color-block t-shirt, navy blue top, beige bottom

attributes.pose: bending forward, reaching into a sack

entities.description: A smiling middle-aged Black woman stands outdoors in a muddy field, wearing a colorful patterned headscarf and a pink t-shirt stained with mud on the front. She is holding the handlebars of a bicycle, with her body facing forward and a bright, joyful expression on her face.

clothing.top: pink short-sleeved t-shirt with mud stains
clothing.bottom: dark patterned pants with floral and leaf motifs
clothing.headwear: colorful headscarf with orange, blue, and green patterns

entities.description: A smiling woman wearing a colorful headscarf and a pink t-shirt stands in the foreground holding the handlebars of a bicycle, while a man in a blue and beige shirt bends over a large burlap sack in the background. They are situated in a flooded rice paddy field with young green shoots emerging from the muddy water.
